description: Leader-Agent completion gate. Before any agent declares done/fixed/shipped/resolved, require tracked session evidence AND recheck parseable factual claims (row counts, file metrics, versions) against configured verifiers. Blocking response when evidence is missing or a factual claim mismatches; callers honor the blocking flag to stop completion claims.

claim.description: The completion claim text to verify (e.g. "Fix shipped", "the row count is 1,284")

goalContract.description: Optional agent handoff contract. Use this when a worker/orchestrator/reviewer loop needs explicit done criteria before a done/fixed/shipped claim is allowed.

doneWhen.description: Human-readable acceptance criteria for the task.

goal.description: The operator-visible goal this claim is trying to close.

mustNotChange.description: Protected areas or constraints the agents must preserve while completing the goal.

orchestratorAgent.description: Agent responsible for routing and deciding whether done can be claimed.

proveBy.description: Tracked action ids required before the claim can pass, such as tests_passed, review_completed, ci_green, deploy_verified, or operator_approved.

mode.description: blocking (default) returns blocking=true when evidence missing or factual claim mismatches; advisory returns blocking=false

sessionId.description: Optional session id to associate with the gate decision

name: require_evidence_for_claim
title: Require Evidence For Claim
